data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for Google Mobile Ads integration
data.what_it_does: Easy Ads Flutter simplifies the integration of Google Mobile Ads into Flutter apps. It supports banners, native ads, app open ads, interstitials, and rewarded ads with Just-in-Time loading and consent management.
use_when: You want to integrate Google Mobile Ads into a Flutter application quickly
You need support for JIT ad loading and event callbacks for ad lifecycles
avoid_when: You need built-in support for Facebook, AppLovin, or Unity ads in the main package version
You prefer implementing ad networks directly via official SDKs without wrappers
strengths: Provides a simple API for loading and displaying various ad formats
Includes a Consent Manager helper for GDPR and privacy options compliance
Supports Just-in-Time (JIT) ad loading for interstitial, app open, and rewarded ads
weaknesses: Main package now only supports AdMob, requiring alternate branches for other networks
Requires platform-specific configuration in Info.plist and AndroidManifest.xml
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the Google Mobile Ads App ID to ios/Runner/Info.plist and android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml, along with SKAdNetworkItems on iOS.

alternatives.name: google_mobile_ads
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want the official, direct Google Mobile Ads SDK without third-party wrapper layers.
